Nelson and I worked on Cooling Cabinet 1 for a few hours.  
 
When we started we had to close many doors as the WDS was not in a state to start up and move molds.  We need to change this going forward and the work is not complete until the WDS can moved atleast 10 molds in auto without a jam.  
 
2 issues we saw with WDS: 
 
1) Many doors open and even buckets of water left on line for cleaning.

This can be solved by a supervisor walkthrough to ensure all molds are put away, all doors are shut, and all cleaning supplies are taken from the line. 
2) Many molds were in the wrong position

We found over 30 molds in the wrong position (assume taken out to clean and then put back in)

Proposed solution is to not put a mold back in once it is taken out and only use the mold exchange area to insert molds

This will prevent start up issues


Adjustments made to cooling cabinet 1: 

Manually loosened bolts and adjusted discharge paternoster chain (where mold sits)Manually tightened main drive chain on discharge paternoster 

We never did this with WDS when they were onsite.  We only tightened the main drive chain for the infeed paternoster
 

TESTING:  We tested and ran the full line for 5 minutes at 10 MPM and then for 10 minutes at 25 MPM.  Without this testing the team would have been delayed 1-2 hours at start up after all the issues found mentioned above.
 
Adjustments made to Gondola: 

Changed the setting for the slats at the discharge from 377 -> 375

There seems to be good clearance now when the bars are pushed off the slats

4 issues we saw with Gondola and conveyors: 

The discharge conveyor from the Gondola to TG5 was not tightened and left loose

This should be a check made by the supervisor
The belt that runs across the scrapper for the discharge to TG4 was not routed correctlyThe gondola was not cleaned well

This needs to be cleaned in the morning before we run.  Multiple bars were found on it and the slats are still not clean

This is one of the most important cleaning assignments as it will directly affect performance for start up Rose Smuin

The new cleaning tool for the Gondola discharge plate was not left in it designed spot

I will post pictures for this in a moment
